plan.description: Add data import/export functionality to TodoStorage class

tdd_sequence.description: Write failing tests for export_to() and import_from() methods
Implement minimal export_to() and import_from() methods
implementation: Add export_to(path: Path, format: str = 'json') -> None
Add import_from(path: Path, format: str = 'json', merge: bool = True) -> list[Todo]
Add validation and clear error messages

acceptance_criteria: export_to() method supports export to specified path
import_from() method imports from external file with merge/replace
Supports both JSON and CSV formats
Imports validate data format and provide clear error messages
risks: CSV format doesn't naturally support nested data structures (timestamps)
Import merge strategy needs to handle ID conflicts
